name: OpenOS 1.4.0
description: Redesigned system dialogs: a rounded card with a left-aligned heading, a muted body and pill buttons; the safe choice is highlighted when the action is destructive. OSA SDK 4 adds custom shapes (star, ngon, pie, pill, per-corner rrect4 and a 48-point path with fill, stroke, move, rotate and scale), anti-aliased drawing via smooth(1), the ui.dialog popup with custom labels, and immediate-mode widgets: ui.button, ui.switch, ui.checkbox, ui.radio, ui.progress, ui.card and ui.chip. confirm() honours its danger flag. The UI Kit app in OpenStore demonstrates all of it.
